bug_semantics: FormFields.add() in @adonisjs/bodyparser copies unauthenticated multipart field names into lodash.set/get via @poppinss/utils. CVE-2026-25754 / GHSA-f5x2-vj4h-vg4c was 'fixed' by changing the root store from {} to Object.create(null), which only stops first-segment payloads such as __proto__.polluted and constructor.prototype.polluted. lodash.set still materializes intermediate objects as plain {}, so nested keys (user.__proto__.polluted, user[__proto__][polluted], user.constructor.prototype.polluted2) write onto Object.prototype process-wide. Any route behind BodyParserMiddleware that accepts multipart/form-data is an unauthenticated remote sink. Affected published ranges are >=10.1.3 <10.1.5 and >=11.0.0-next.9 <11.0.3; v11.0.2 still carries Object.create(null) without path-segment rejection even though the GHSA text stops at 11.0.1. Closure rejects keys whose lodash.toPath() segments include __proto__, prototype, or constructor.
flaw_origin: The first public write of this residual nested-pollution mechanism is 40e1c71f958cffb74f6b91bed6630dca979062ed on 11.x: it swapped src/form_fields.ts #fields from {} to Object.create(null) and added only root-level proto tests, leaving FormFields.add's unsanitized lodash.set(this.#fields, key, ...) intact. Parent 3017053886993908d181fd721ea1b7f66e91f470 still has #fields = {} and no Object.create(null). 2515698a53899b8c761d43ac342d6a6271c852ad (two minutes later on 10.x) is a same-message reapplication, not a smaller BIC. Pre-2019 lodash.set usage is the original CVE-2026-25754 sink, outside this advisory's affected window.

reasoning: CVE-2026-48795 is a published incomplete-remediation of CVE-2026-25754, not a withdrawn advisory. The original sink was FormFields.add feeding attacker-controlled multipart names into lodash.set on a prototype-inheriting store. The 2026-02-05 patch that GitHub and CVE.org treat as the CVE-2026-25754 fix only null-prototype-d the root object and tested direct proto keys; lodash.set continued to create intermediate {} objects, so nested proto segments still polluted Object.prototype. That residual mechanism is this CVE. The smallest public first-write of the incomplete protection is 40e1c71f958cffb74f6b91bed6630dca979062ed on 11.x (src/form_fields.ts #fields = Object.create(null) with no path sanitization). Its immediate parent 3017053886993908d181fd721ea1b7f66e91f470 still has #fields = {} and no Object.create(null), so the incomplete-fix lines are absent there. 2515698 on 10.x is a two-minute-later same-message reapplication that starts the 10.1.3 affected window; it is not a squash member of 40e1c71 and is not a smaller BIC. Pre-existing lodash.set (Harminder Virk, 2019) is the original CVE's BIC candidate and predates this advisory's affected range, so it is not inverted into this case's introducer. Complete closure on the BIC line is aa96908f7b3f64c19e15d2d2d916b69137bdf469 (v11.0.3); 8a85eb0c2061b0caca10faedbfc2cf24b56cf9f6 is the 10.x twin (v10.1.5). AI is judged only from the 40e1c71 commit object: human author/committer Romain Lanz, GPG signature, no AI/bot trailers. PR-body and later complete-fix authorship are ignored for attribution. Verdict is NOT_AI: real nested prototype-pollution vulnerability, human BIC, patched.
